name: blind-7b
rationale: From step 200 the entity runs a fixed retry loop: it repeats the same nine actions in the same order with a period of 23 steps, and each action draws back the same result each time (a fixed vector plus reading noise), labelled elicited. Each result is about 3 D from the entity's other states and the external held before it, and with the period longer than the 21-step short window it is not a confirmation, so the short news looks present. The entity takes each result up at the normal rate, so short-horizon gain looks intact, which is what healthy sensing through one's own tool calls looks like. But nothing new arrives: every result repeats one already in the session's record, so long news is at zero. The entity keeps coming back to the same states once per cycle, and no innovation lasts past a cycle, so persistent gain is gone. This is a closed loop on the entity's side (an agent stuck re-issuing the same calls), not open work. When it asks at 460 the partner gives fresh, informative answers, but the entity keeps cycling and takes none of them up, so the reading after the probe is still closed loop.
